s.note: Sonny taking Julian out to the sports bar
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp hot sauce for 3 minutes and toss the wings through, then bake 5 minutes more. Mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and garlic powder for the ranch. Scatter wings with spring onion.

Mix 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp poppy seeds, 1 tsp dried onion flakes, 1/2 tsp garlic flakes and 1/2 tsp sea salt. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 sliced spring onions until fluffy. Grill 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.

m.note: Sonny letting Julian make all the rules
m.how: Bake 800g frozen crinkle-cut chips and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 25 minutes. Grill 6 rashers bacon. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Set out lettuce, tomato, pickles, bacon, onion rings, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.

w.note: Julian and his favourite toy, Scuba Steve
w.how: Make 1 packet blue jelly with 500ml boiling water, set in a shallow dish for 3 hours and cut into cubes. Crush 6 plain sweet biscuits into sand. In 4 tall glasses, layer jelly cubes, 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and more jelly. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, a sprinkle of biscuit sand, a few gummy fish and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.

d.how: Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes and drizzle chocolate sauce down the insides. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp chocolate malt powder and 2 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with a little more malt powder.
